summary.text: Kim Hicks is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 25A, with a tenure beginning in 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hicks has worked as a direct support worker and teacher.

paragraphs.text: Kim Hicks earned a B.A. in special education from Winona State University.
Her career experience includes working as a direct support worker and teacher.
Hicks succeeded Duane Quam in District 25A and took office on January 3, 2023.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Children and Families Finance and Policy, Human Services Finance and Policy, and Higher Education Finance and Policy committees.
